content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The Ballistic Missile Defense Terminal Defense Segment is a Missile Defense Agency (MDA) research and development program that provides forward-deployable capabilities to support regional missile defense operations.","citation":{"fact_id":"57f3cbd8c8399e43"}},{"text":"Its centerpiece is the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) system, which gives Combatant Commands a globally-transportable, rapidly-deployable capability to intercept and destroy short-range, medium-range, and limited intermediate-range missile threats inside or outside the atmosphere during the terminal (final) phase of a missile's flight.","citation":{"fact_id":"88c3990ce7f2b6e3"}},{"text":"The program also covers Patriot Advanced Capability-3 (PAC-3), an operational land-based weapon built on the U.S. Army's PATRIOT (Phased Array Tracking Radar Intercept on Target) air and missile defense infrastructure; the Army handles PAC-3 production while MDA funds interoperability and integration with the broader Missile Defense System.","citation":{"fact_id":"f898ccb0e3b59897"}},{"text":"The THAAD Development effort executes iterative development and integration of multiple independent system builds, including integrating the THAAD weapon system into the Army's Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS) architecture.","citation":{"fact_id":"274cd2713ef9fc10"}},{"text":"A Cyber Operations project sustains MDA's Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Controls Validation Testing activities and supports THAAD authorizations to operate within the Missile Defense System.","citation":{"fact_id":"5eab12ec50ef58e7"}},{"text":"A Program-Wide Support (PWS) project covers non-headquarters management costs — such as government civilians, contract support, security, and facilities — allocated on a pro-rata basis across most MDA program elements, meaning its share fluctuates each year with the total agency budget.","citation":{"fact_id":"e1ef32d546f1161f"}},{"text":"The program is funded through the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"a6af898ced1ea3b2"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"Funding for the program is set to rise sharply, with the FY2026 total request of $646.898 million (about $646.9 million) more than double the FY2025 total of $285.279 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"57f3cbd8c8399e43"}},{"text":"That represents an increase of roughly $361.6 million, or about 127%, from FY2025 to FY2026 — a change large enough that it was flagged as a year-over-year budget swing.","citation":{"fact_id":"01d254e071a59b5b"}},{"text":"MDA's budget monitors flagged the program as increasing 127% from FY25 to FY26.","citation":{"fact_id":"9fe02a7529418101"}},{"text":"The FY2026 total is built from a $508.898 million discretionary request plus a $138.0 million reconciliation request.","citation":{"fact_id":"66643da2830e4ef8"}},{"text":"The reconciliation portion of the FY2026 request is $138.0 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"3281b39b88c41f59"}},{"text":"Actual spending in FY2024 was $224.457 million, so the FY2026 request represents a substantial ramp-up over recent years.","citation":{"fact_id":"8f6ac25c843423fe"}},{"text":"The budget submission reflects a January 27, 2025 Executive Order that set a goal of protecting U.S. citizens and critical infrastructure against missile attack, prompting MDA to accelerate next-generation defenses against ballistic, hypersonic, cruise, and other advanced missile threats.","citation":{"fact_id":"57f3cbd8c8399e43"}},{"text":"Planned next-generation THAAD builds would add advanced threat algorithms enabling engagement of seven new advanced threats, including hypersonic non-ballistic missiles.","citation":{"fact_id":"274cd2713ef9fc10"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The Missile Defense Agency (MDA) is the program's managing organization.","citation":{"fact_id":"57f3cbd8c8399e43"}},{"text":"Lobbying filings from Lockheed Martin Corporation referenced missile defense matters; a 2024 filing described its lobbying on \"F-35 funding, Army Missile Defense.\"","citation":{"fact_id":"0660b6f1a3db335b"}},{"text":"A 2026 Lockheed Martin filing reported lobbying on the FY2026 Department of Defense Appropriations Act (S 2572/HR 4016) including issues related to space and missile defense.","citation":{"fact_id":"002d7f7f516bc2f9"}},{"text":"The Boeing Company reported lobbying activity that matched the term \"Missile,\" including a 2024 filing referencing the FY24 Department of Defense Appropriations Act.","citation":{"fact_id":"005fc74423472220"}},{"text":"A 2026 Boeing filing referenced the FY2026 Department of Defense Appropriations Act (H.R.4016 & S.2572).","citation":{"fact_id":"01bfec7dbc6c2604"}},{"text":"Northrop Grumman Corporation filed a 2026 lobbying report referencing defense appropriations and authorization measures that matched the term \"Missile.\"","citation":{"fact_id":"0d2a841400d53f8e"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
